description: This file contains unit tests for IPC (Inter-Process Communication) mechanisms within the WPEFramework, including classes for responses, triplets, and handlers for IPC messages, as well as tests for different channel configurations (continuous, flash, multi-channel, reversed).

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents a response with a result code.

classes.name: Triplet
classes.description: Represents a triplet with display, surface, and context identifiers.

classes.name: HandleTripletResponse
classes.description: Handles IPC requests for triplet responses, computes sum of display, surface, and context.

classes.name: HandleVoidTriplet
classes.description: Handles IPC requests that respond with a predefined triplet.

classes.name: HandleTextText
classes.description: Handles IPC requests involving text parameters and responses.

methods.name: Procedure
methods.description: Implements the RPC procedure for each handler class, processing incoming IPC messages.
